Project.title: Civic Tech Project
Project.description: A publicly listed Philippine LGU civic technology project seeking or having secured infrastructure sponsorship.

slug.description: URL-safe slug combining project name and project reference ID.

projectName.description: Public title of the civic technology project.

lguName.description: Target municipality, city, or local government unit.

province.description: Philippine province or region (e.g. Metro Manila).

description.description: Overview of what the civic tech project does for citizens.

temporaryUrl.description: Current temporary deployment URL where visitors can inspect the project.

preferredDomain.description: Requested domain name for the project.

maintainerName.description: Maintainer full name or preferred public name.

maintainerEmail.description: Public contact email for direct sponsor inquiries.

maintainerContactLink.description: Preferred direct contact link such as Facebook, Messenger, or LinkedIn.

sponsorshipStatus.description: Current sponsorship state of the project.

sponsorshipConfirmationNote.description: Optional public acknowledgment note added when marked as Sponsored.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when the project was published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent update.

sponsoredAt.description: Server timestamp recorded when the project transitioned to Sponsored, or null.

consentTimestamp.description: Server timestamp confirming maintainer public-listing consent.

isPublic.description: Explicit public visibility flag for directory list queries.

ProjectSecret.title: Project Management Secret
ProjectSecret.description: Write-only private management token hash stored separately from public project listings.

ProjectTokenLookup.title: Management Token Lookup
ProjectTokenLookup.description: Domain-separated lookup hash mapping a private management link to its corresponding project ID.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Public directory of civic technology projects with zero private credential fields.

/project_secrets/{projectId}.description: Non-readable cryptographic management token hash used to authorize atomic project edits.

/project_tokens/{lookupHash}.description: Non-listable lookup mapping a domain-separated token hash to a project reference ID.
